conditions.B: same H9 matrix with F9 column removed; no reaggregation
conditions.C: native H9-v2 F1..F8+C3, unchanged existing calculation and aggregation

preprocessing: Separate StandardScaler per condition and training fold only; 12 training samples; no imputation
metric_semantics: Per seed pool 24 OOF predictions, average six class F1s; then mean and population SD across seeds. Participant F1 means reported separately. Seeds are not additional people.

benchmark.boundary: StandardScaler.transform(raw 1xd row) plus LR.predict; preallocated already aggregated row; no feature aggregation/image processing/I/O
benchmark.schedule: round-robin conditions; rotate start by seed+fold; cycle the same 12 held-out segments
benchmark.gc: disabled in measured loops and restored
benchmark.model_size: uncompressed pickle protocol=5 classifier+scaler; not RAM or library size

privacy: Private inputs, sample-level matrices/predictions, fitted scalers and models are not included.
